steps.say: Open Setup, set every port to SIM and launch. Everything here runs on simulated hardware.
Enter the tip ID, then press Arm trial. The station takes a picture of the stage.
Press Capture region and drag a rectangle on the picture of the stage, over the part to watch. Then use it.
The recording is running. Lower the tip, and press Mark force when the force is right.
When the cut is done, press End recording.
Review the trial, add a note if you like, then press Finish trial to keep it.
